name: Root-feeding nematodes
description: Plant-parasitic nematodes that pierce living roots and suck out cell contents (called 'phytophagous nematodes' in the source). Functional group pooling all root-feeding nematode species of the site, grouped by the source on the basis of their shared diet. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
